title: Permutahedra, Lusztig varieties, degenerations, and subdivisions
summary: We present an embedded (in $G/B$) degeneration of Lusztig varieties (which generalize type $A$ Hessenberg varieties) to certain unions of Richardson varieties, giving a simultaneous reproof (and extension) of results of Anderson--Tymoczko, Harada--Horiguchi--Masuda--Park, and Kim. Although torus-equivariant, the degeneration is not Gröbner.
